debugMessages.content: I could not fully participate in the group discussion because my partner left, so I had to complete the task on my own. prompt_mistake.value: I did not make any mistakes in remembering the labels I used. However, I could not fully participate in the game as intended because my partner left, so I had to complete it on my own rather than agree labels as part of a group. This meant there was no group discussion or shared strategy, but I still tried to keep the labels short, clear, and based on the most obvious visual features.
